name: 62691 · Virginia, IL
findings: ZIP 62691 (Virginia) has 13 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62691 (Virginia) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62691 (Virginia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
